title: ございます — the polite “there is / it is”
summary: ございます is the very polite form of あります (to exist, to have) and, after a noun, of です. It is used by shop staff, hotel staff and in formal announcements.

patterns.form: 名詞 ＋ に ＋ ございます
patterns.gloss: “It is located at ～” (replaces にあります)

patterns.form: 名詞 ＋ が ＋ ございます／ございましたら
patterns.gloss: “There is ～” / “If you have ～” (replaces があります)

body.p: ございます is the humble-polite word for ある. It sounds one step more courteous than あります and is a fixed choice when speaking to customers.
Use it to tell where something is (受付は一階にございます) or to say that something exists (ご質問がございましたら). The greetings おはようございます and ありがとうございます also contain this ございます.
It is very polite and fits service situations; do not use it with friends. The negative is ございません.

examples.ja: 受付（うけつけ）は一階（いっかい）にございます。
examples.tr: The reception is on the first floor.

examples.ja: トイレは二階（にかい）にございます。
examples.tr: The restroom is on the second floor.

examples.ja: ご質問（しつもん）がございましたら、お聞（き）きください。
examples.tr: If you have any questions, please ask.
examples.note: ございましたら = ございます in the “if” form.

pitfalls: Do not use it with friends or family; ある or あります is enough.
For people, 〜がいる is normally rendered as おります or いらっしゃいます. ございます is mainly for things and places.
